fomod.Name: OStim Together
fomod.Author: OStim Together project
fomod.Description: Synchronizes OStim Standalone scenes through Skyrim Together Reborn. v0.37.1 preserves the mirror-only OCum model and owner-authored live visibility from v0.37.0, but fixes remote Body [OvlN] materialization: when an OCum body overlay is visible on its owner, the STR proxy now queues RaceMenu's real Add-only overlay rebuild so the mesh is reinstalled against the proxy's current body/skin before owner visibility is reapplied. This replaces the ineffective RevertOverlay pseudo-relink without changing the local player, PPA, scene anchors or alignment.
